feedback.title: Calibration warning alerts for Rosemount flow meters
feedback.description: The system should warn warehouse supervisors when flow transmitter spares have been in shelf storage for over 18 months without recalibration.

decisions.title: Approval of alternative step-down regulator
decisions.details: Approved the LM2596S-5.0 as direct alternate for older LM2596 step-down converters in RTU panel boards.
decisions.rationale: Supply chain delays for original parts threatened shutdown of the oil manifold telemetry. Extensive laboratory heat-load tests at 75C showed excellent voltage stability with no failure over 48 hours.

decisions.title: Rejection of non-certified alternate manifold sensor
decisions.details: Rejected Al-Faras alternative transmitter offer due to failure to supply API/ATEX hazardous area certificates.
decisions.rationale: The Instrument Department of ZFOD operates under strict zone 0/1 explosion prevention guidelines. Standard parts without ATEX certificates present unacceptable risk in hydrocarbon processing lines.

decisions.title: Maintenance Lesson: Seal integrity on high-temp pumps
decisions.details: Identified premature failure on bearing assemblies due to usage of rubber seals (2RS) instead of steel shields (2Z) on pumps operating above 120C.
decisions.rationale: Lessons learned registered: Steel shielded bearings (2Z) must always be selected for auxiliary pump assemblies in Area 3 hot oil circuits. Avoid standard elastomer seals as they melt and degrade rapidly.
